description: Fetch a web page through a self-hosted Proxlane gateway, which fails over between scraping APIs and checks every response for block pages. Returns the page as text. On failure returns {ok:false, outcome, class, retryable, reason}: a blocked or captcha page is reported as a failure, never returned as content. Do not retry immediately when retryable is true; the gateway has already tried other providers.

country.description: Two-letter country to fetch from, e.g. "us" or "de".

format.description: "text" (default) for readable text, "html" for the raw page.

max_chars.description: Truncate the result to this many characters.

render.description: Run JavaScript before the snapshot. Costs several times more; use only when the page needs it.

url.description: The page to fetch, http or https.

wait_for.description: A CSS selector to wait for before the snapshot. Implies render. The page is a failure if it never appears.

name: fetch_page
title: Fetch a web page
